P.name: Sap Magic
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Maokai''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and {{tip|heal}} him for {{as|{{pplevel|4; then +0.2*x for 5;then +0.65*x|formula=3.8 + 0.2 per level until level 6, then +0.65 per level|key=%}} '''maximum''' health}} after a {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Reduced by attack speed.}}-second delay.
P.description2: Each time '''Maokai''' casts an {{tip|ability}}, hits at least one enemy champion or epic monster with ''{{ai|Sapling Toss|Maokai}}'', or is struck by an enemy's ability, ''Sap Magic's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 4 seconds, modified to {{fd|1.5}} if he is hit by a large {{tip|monster|monster's}} basic attack or ability.
P.description3: ''Sap Magic {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Maokai's''' basic attack timer, and will not trigger if he is above {{sti|{{as|95% '''maximum''' health}}}}.''

Q.name: Bramble Smash
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Maokai''' sends a shockwave in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds. ''Bramble Smash'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|75 to 255}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2 to 4}}% of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|150 to 190}}|Total Monster Damage|{{ap|75+150 to 255+190}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2 to 4}}% of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: Enemies near '''Maokai''' are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} up to 300 units based on their proximity to him.

W.name: Twisted Advance
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Maokai''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy while being {{tip|untargetable}}. Upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration.
W.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 160}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1 to 1.4}} seconds}}

E.name: Sapling Toss
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Maokai''' flings a ''Sapling'' to the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Can see across terrain from the center, but not into brush}} while it is in-flight.
E.description2: Once landed, the ''Sapling'' grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and remains stationary for 30 seconds or until it reacts to the first nearby visible enemy, chasing them for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds. The ''Sapling'' explodes upon colliding with an enemy or when it expires, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, capped at 300 against non-champions, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 45% for 2 seconds.
E.description3:
A ''Sapling'' placed in a {{tip|brush}} becomes empowered: lasting 30 {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}} seconds and causing its explosion to deal {{fd|66.7}}% damage to non-{{tip|minion}} targets struck and attach two ''Saplings'' to them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, as well as {{tip|slow}} enemies hit by 45% {{as|(+ 1% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} {{as|(+ 1% per 100 AP)}} for 2 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|reveal}} them for 3 seconds. The attached ''Saplings'' explode on the afflicted target every {{fd|0.75}} seconds over the duration, dealing them the same damage each time.

Targets can only be attached to two ''Saplings'' at a time; subsequent empowered ''Sapling'' explosions on a target will refresh the duration and only attach a ''Sapling'' if one has exploded on them already. Against minions, the explosion deals 100% damage. The '''total''' damage is capped at 600 against non-champions.

R.name: Nature's Grasp
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Maokai''' summons a colossal wall of five thorny brambles that slowly advances in the target direction, accelerating over time, each stopping when they collide with an enemy {{tip|champion}}. Hitting at least one enemy champion grants '''Maokai''' {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 2 seconds.
R.description2: Each bramble deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for {{pp|type=distance traveled|0.75 to 2.25|0 to 1000 by 100|formula=Starts at 0.75 seconds and increases up to 2.25 seconds over 1000 units traveled}} seconds.
